title: Cover the untested task sync refusal producers and tighten the refusal code docs
outcome: Cover the untested task sync refusal producers and tighten the refusal code docs
acceptance: Each task sync refusal producer without a direct test gets one asserting its code: export of an external or source-snapshot item, non_utf8_name, no_parent, appeared, file_grew, task_limit, tree_limit, an export activity conflict, local note divergence, a record-id pin, and a symlinked task file
A test makes the documented-codes check fail when a TaskSyncRefusal variant is missing from the list it iterates
The refusal codes docs state the destination parent and no_parent wording, the oversized-note details shape, and whether a --json receipt carries per-file path context
A guard asserts that a locked-store failure during task sync is not classified as a task sync refusal

completion.summary: Added direct task-sync refusal producer tests and exhaustive documentation-inventory omission controls; clarified parent/no_parent, oversized-note and JSON-path contracts; verified real Windows SQLite lock refusal retains the generic code. All review findings corrected and rereviewed. Committed, pushed and installed the exact validated source.
